g.text: (DP.7)–(DP.8) apply these kernels to boundary vectors and adjoints. (DP.5) and (DP.11) control tails and joint limits; normal GNS representations give the intrinsic seminorms.
Original figure and proof. Scalar antecedents: Vizeff, Berkeley Complex Analysis, Lectures 6, 9–11; spectral antecedent: Kowalski, Theorems 3.1 and 4.42.
